steps.label: 3031-own-paper1094-saved-five-modify
command: (()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('paperId')!=='1094'||location.pathname!=='/paper/detail.donga')throw Error('Own paper detail');const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].find(e=>{const u=new URL(e.href);return u.pathname==='/paper/modify.donga'&&u.searchParams.get('paperId')==='1094';});if(!a)throw Error('Modify missing');a.click();return {clicked:true};})()

steps.label: 3037-own-paper1094-current-independent-and-cancel-controls
command: (async()=>{const r=await fetch('/paper/detail.donga?paperId=1094',{credentials:'same-origin'});if(!r.ok||r.redirected)throw Error('Readback unavailable');const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(await r.text(),'text/html');return {serverCurrentItemIds:[...d.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/item/all/detail.donga?itemId="]')].map(e=>new URL(e.getAttribute('href'),location.origin).searchParams.get('itemId')),modals:[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].map(m=>({id:m.id,text:m.innerText,html:m.querySelector('.modal-footer')?.outerHTML})),cancelLinks:[...document.querySelectorAll('#paperModifyForm a.btn')].map(e=>({text:e.textContent,href:e.getAttribute('href'),attributes:{...e.dataset}}))};})()
